generalTab.textTitleSearchBehaviour: Choose how strictly entered search terms need to match.
generalTab.textSearchAndConditionExplain: Show only results that match all entered search terms.

generalTab.textEmptyStateExcludedSearchTermsDescrip: Exclude search terms to stop them from being matched in your Sales Channels' search results.
generalTab.labelExcludedSearchTermsNoResultsDescrip: Try adjusting your search to find what you're looking for.
generalTab.textDescriptionSearchableContent: All searchable content is listed in the table below. To customise search results in your Sales Channels go ahead and either exclude content from being searchable at all or tweak the ranking of each individual element to your liking. Higher ranking elements have an increased "search value" and will place higher in the search results.
generalTab.textEmptyStateSearchableContentDescripti: Add searchable content to control what can be found in your Sales Channels' search.

modal.textExplain: Below you'll find three fictional search results for the search term "jeans". Searchable are product titles (ranking score 100), product descriptions (ranking score 50) and product tags (ranking score 20).
modal.textProductRankedFirstScore: The product ranked first has a search hit in every searchable entity, resulting in a total ranking score of 170.
modal.textProductRankedSecondScore: The product ranked second has search hits for product name and product tags, resulting in a total ranking score of 120.
modal.textProductRankedThirdScore: The product ranked third has only one hit in product tags, resulting in a total ranking score of 20.

liveSearchTab.textDescription: Test your custom search settings below.
liveSearchTab.textNoResultDescription: Please try again with another search term.
liveSearchTab.scoreHelpText: Elasticsearch's combined relevance for this result. Within each field it keeps the strongest matching clause and adds a small fraction of the weaker ones (fuzzy, prefix, partial), then multiplies by the field's weight. The bars shown here are already weight-scaled, so fields with different weights can be compared directly. Each bar shows only a field's strongest clause, so together they stop a little short of the total — the gap is those weaker same-field clauses, which aren't drawn separately. The same word can also score differently in two fields — each field's score reflects how rare the word is there and how short that field's text is.
liveSearchTab.scoreColumnHelpText: The result's position in the current order, its relevance score, and a bar showing that score relative to the best-scoring result. Select a row's score to see how it is composed.
liveSearchTab.uniformScoresHint: All results share the same score, so their order here is not meaningful.

matchTypeTooltip.exact: The whole search word matches a word in this field exactly.
matchTypeTooltip.fuzzy: Matched with typo tolerance — the word differs by one or two letters.
matchTypeTooltip.prefix: A word in this field starts with the search word.
matchTypeTooltip.ngram: Matched a shared letter fragment rather than the whole word. The fragment length is set by the SHOPWARE_ES_NGRAM_MIN_GRAM and SHOPWARE_ES_NGRAM_MAX_GRAM environment variables.
matchTypeTooltip.phrase: The full search phrase appears in this field, in order — the strongest signal, weighted above the individual word matches.
